name: sdk-config-fallback-model
about: sdkSessionConfig.fallbackModel（SessionAgentConfigBundle.ts:127 resolveFallbackModel → 路由的 fallbackModels）：主模型 bbx/broken 回 500 后切到 SDK 指定的回退模型；路由未开启时也生效。服务端校验（ProjectRuntimeRegistry.ts:1009 resolveSdkConfiguredModel）：未知模型、有歧义的裸模型名回 INVALID_SDK_FALLBACK_MODEL；唯一的裸模型名通过校验但 resolveSdkModel 无斜杠时退回主模型（即不回退）。比较事件、发给 provider 的请求、会话落盘。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/broken
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    alt:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
